entry.title: New: Resolution 561 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE TO ENTER INTO NEGOTIATIONS FOR THE ACQUISITION OF LANDS AND/OR A CONSERVATION EASEMENT FOR ALL OR A PORTION OF THE PROPERTY IDENTIFIED AS TAX MAP KEYS: 7-6-021:016 AND 017, SITUATED IN HŌLUALOA, DISTRICT OF NORTH KONA, UTILIZING THE PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION FUND

The County seeks to acquire approximately 68.84 acres of land to protect and preserve cultural and natural resources and open certain areas of the property for education, gathering, and cultural practices. The parcel is listed as priority number eight in the 2022 Annual Report of the Public Access, Open Space, and Natural Resources Preservation Commission.
